questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Dolphins?
At Wanderers, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Lions?
Who scored South Africa Women's first-ever Test century, an unbeaten 105 against England in Cape Town in 1961?
questions.explanation: Van Mentz's record stood for over 60 years until Marizanne Kapp passed it with 150 against England in 2022.

questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.

questions.question: At which ground did Thembela Ngcobo record their career-best bowling figures (3-15, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Boland on 2023/11/19.
